errors.IPC_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE: Update all MLCCS Video Search components to the same version.
errors.IPC_FRAME_TOO_LARGE: Restart the affected component and preserve its diagnostic report.
errors.CAPABILITY_SPEECH_REQUIRES_CUDA: Use a supported NVIDIA CUDA driver or disable speech indexing.
errors.MODEL_HASH_MISMATCH: Discard the partial file and retry a trusted mirror.
errors.MODEL_DISK_FULL: Choose a storage location with more free space.
errors.INDEX_MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE: Reconnect the library drive and resume the task.
errors.INDEX_RETRY_EXHAUSTED: Review the item error and retry manually after correcting the cause.
errors.UPDATE_SIGNATURE_INVALID: Do not install this update; retain the current version.
errors.UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETED: The prior version was restored after the new version failed its health check.
errors.DIAGNOSTIC_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Review the collection and explicitly approve upload.
errors.DIAGNOSTIC_REDACTION_FAILED: Save locally and review; the report was not uploaded.
